Ethan had always approached life with a buoyant optimism, his golden retriever personality making him a magnet for friends and an endless source of energy. His days at the university had typically been filled with a satisfying rhythm of lectures, study sessions, and social interactions. But today was different.

Despite his usually upbeat demeanor, Ethan found himself struggling with an uncharacteristic moodiness.
